description: This file defines a GatewaySession class and related data structures that manage WebSocket connections to a gateway server, handle authentication, message exchange, and session management for a client application. It includes connection establishment, request/response handling, event processing, and reconnection logic.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Contains metadata about the client connecting to the gateway, such as ID, display name, version, platform, and device info.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Holds options for establishing a connection, including role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, client info, and user agent.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Details of errors encountered during connection, including code, retry capability, and next step recommendations.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Represents the selected authentication method during connection, including tokens and source.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Main class managing session lifecycle, connection handling, requests, events, and reconnection logic to the gateway server.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Structure representing an invocation request sent to the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Result of an invocation, indicating success, payload, or error details.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Structured error details including code, message, and optional additional info.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiate a connection to a specified gateway endpoint with optional tokens and settings.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the current endpoint.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event notification to the connection.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a request to the gateway with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests the latest canvas capability information from the node.
